title: Twenty tests with no real effects
caption: The number of false positives is B(20, 0.05). P(at least one) = 1 − 0.95²⁰ = 0.642: about two chances in three of a spurious finding.
alt: Bar chart of B(20, 0.05); the bars for 1 to 20 false positives are shaded, total 0.642.
description: Each test has a 5% chance of a false positive.
Everything else, 0.642, is at least one false positive.
